provider: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information / NOAA Open Data Dissemination (NODD)
api_version: GHCN-Daily rolling 3.x; original ghcnd-version.txt and ghcnd-countries.txt objects

request_contract.parameter_rules: Two fixed anonymous HTTPS GETs only: https://noaa-ghcn-pds.s3.amazonaws.com/ghcnd-version.txt and https://noaa-ghcn-pds.s3.amazonaws.com/ghcnd-countries.txt; no query, redirect, caller-selected path/station/year/URL/headers or object listing. Max 4096 bytes per object and total 8192 bytes. No retries. Strict UTF-8 parsing: one rolling update/version pair, unique two-character GHCN country codes with names. This metadata probe does not retrieve, authorize, or admit any GHCN observation files. Country codes are GHCN-native, NOT ISO-3166 without independent crosswalk.

response_contract.format: NOAA NODD original small UTF-8 text version metadata and GHCN-native country-code list; not observation CSV.
response_contract.scientific_semantics: Version identity and GHCN country-code metadata are useful acquisition/lineage prerequisites only. The rolling update can change; GHCN country codes are a dataset-native vocabulary, not proof of ISO-3166 or insured geography. The station observation archive integrates heterogeneous sources and QA flags; no observation, hazard event, peril frequency, insurer exposure or model fitness is established by this probe.

operational_constraints.rate_limit_notes: Exactly two small anonymous public-object GETs on explicit --live, no retry, loop, directory traversal, listing, bulk station file or scheduled acquisition. NODD notes that AWS GHCN prefixes can change; exact paths must be re-reviewed rather than guessed.
operational_constraints.mutability_notes: NOAA publishes a rolling GHCN-Daily update identity and fully reprocessed version. Record retrieval UTC, exact object paths, response byte counts and SHA-256 plus code SHA; never infer immutable snapshot identity from a rolling product label.

rights_and_policy.notes: NOAA's NODD registry explicitly identifies GHCN-Daily data distributed by the public no-account noaa-ghcn-pds bucket as CC0-1.0, allows unrestricted reuse, asks for NOAA attribution and prohibits implying NOAA endorsement or mislabeling modified data as original. This particular contract is restricted to two NOAA-distributed public text metadata objects. It does NOT change the independently fail-closed rights review for other NCEI archival interfaces, contributor-level data semantics or future bulk observation ingestion. Public anonymous S3 GET is a static-object access route, not a claim about separate commercial API entitlements.

expected_evidence: Two fixed HTTPS 200 responses with no redirects, query strings or user-controlled URLs
Strict UTF-8 rolling GHCN 3.x update/reprocessed version marker and nonempty validated unique GHCN country codes
Two bounded original-content SHA-256 and byte counts, retrieval UTC and script hash; no raw provider bytes persisted
No weather observations or CAT model input admitted; no ISO-3166 country mapping inferred

notes: The fixed version and country-code endpoints responded with public text on 2026-11-02 during external live review. The exact Python program still needs its own hosted execution receipt; response visibility through a web viewer is not byte/hash proof. No external bytes are committed, no station observations are copied, and no Neon/model input admission is performed.
